quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
Source confirms that the start time for the Hawks home opener against the Rockets on Saturday, Oct. 24 has been changed from 8:00 to 8:30 pm ET.

Tip-off is being pushed back as part of the shuffling to move the Atlanta Dream WNBA Finals game to State Farm Arena earlier that day.
